title: Topic 6 流行
japanese_text: 「ガチャ」と呼ばれる、<u>抽選</u>でキャラクターがあたるシステムは、今は大半のスマホゲームに広まっている。お金がかかるのでもうやめよう、と思っても「あと１回で当たるかも」と<u>悪魔</u>がささやいてくる。
english_translation: The gacha system, in which players are awarded characters by random draw, has now spread widely to the majority of smartphone games. Even if you decide to stop playing because it costs money, the devil will still whisper in your ear, "Just one more time—you might win..."
